description:
Use this when the user asks how an Indian company is exposed to a macro factor such as crude oil or the rupee-dollar rate, and whether the latest official move in it is large enough to matter.

Returns the company's reviewed exposures to macro factors that apply on `as_of_date` (ISO, default today), and for crude oil and USD/INR whether the latest official move (PPAC Indian crude basket, FBIL reference rate) is large enough to flag, with a `coverage` entry for every factor asked about. Only crude oil and USD/INR are monitored; other factors report that no source is available. `factors` is a list from: crude_oil, usd_inr, interest_rates, gold_price, silver_price, steel_price, aluminium_price, government_capex, real_estate_activity, power_sector_capex, renewable_policy_and_tenders. It gives context and never says a move caused or will cause a result. For the plain list of exposures use get_company_exposures.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
